mapper.select: SELECT m_op.evaluatee_id as empId, e1.name as empName, b.branch_name as branchName, e_op.score as operationalScore, e_ma.score as managerScore, m_op.period_id as periodId, e_op.eval_id as evaluationId FROM evaluator_mappings_51 m_op INNER JOIN employees_51 e1 ON m_op.evaluatee_id = e1.emp_id LEFT JOIN branch_managers_51 bm ON e1.emp_id = bm.emp_id LEFT JOIN branches_51 b ON bm.branch_id = b.branch_id INNER JOIN evaluations_51 e_op ON m_op.mapping_id = e_op.mapping_id LEFT JOIN evaluator_mappings_51 m_ma ON m_op.evaluatee_id = m_ma.evaluatee_id AND m_op.period_id = m_ma.period_id AND m_ma.relation_type_code = 'MANAGER' AND m_ma.is_deleted = 'n' LEFT JOIN evaluations_51 e_ma ON m_ma.mapping_id = e_ma.mapping_id WHERE m_op.period_id = #{periodId} AND m_op.relation_type_code = 'OPERATIONAL' AND m_op.is_deleted = 'n'

SELECT TOP (#{periodLimit}) p.period_name as periodName, e.score as score FROM evaluations_51 e JOIN evaluator_mappings_51 m ON e.mapping_id = m.mapping_id JOIN evaluation_periods_51 p ON m.period_id = p.period_id WHERE m.evaluatee_id = #{empId} AND m.relation_type_code = 'OPERATIONAL' AND m.is_deleted = 'n' ORDER BY p.period_year DESC, p.period_id DESC
